name: Orra — Payments Platform
description: A warm, restrained landing page for Orra, a payments platform: a hero whose headline follows a crossfading product showcase with progress thumbnails and status chips, a drifting wall of payment-method tiles, HTML card terminals and a fanned card stack, autoplaying dashboard tabs with an assistant mockup, a customer story carousel, a lit planet of digits for developers, support, CTA and a scroll-linked product rail — plus brand guidelines.
designedFor: Fintech, payments and banking products that need a calm, premium landing page
SaaS platforms with several products to show — tabs, cards and a product index
Seeing scene carousels, scroll-linked rails and autoplaying tabs the editor can drive
